blocks.label: Drain a foe move's PP and store a charge when I hit
blocks.summary: When my damaging move hits, the foe's last-used move (or a random one) loses 1 PP and I store a charge, up to 3. Stored charges power up my draining moves.
examples: Each time I land a hit, take 1 PP from the move the foe used last
feasibility: The foe must have a move with PP left to drain
blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE for the EFFECT only. The trigger (after my hit) and every condition are separate: the attack condition is a real constructor slot bound to move.damaging, the other three clauses are the gate (legacy-closure, requests in requests/B13.md). Why the effect cannot be split with today's blocks: it drains one PP from a foe move that is chosen by a remembered per-foe name or by a random draw, adds to a private charge counter capped at 3, and remembers the last move record so a multi-hit move counts once. There is no 'drain PP' effect and no 'charge counter' memory block in the library (both requested), and the counter is read by a different place (HitHealAttr), so splitting would re-implement the class. Users: Foul Harvest (5973, attr 0). ODDITIES (not fixed): (1) apply stores lastMoveRecord BEFORE its simulated and empty-moveset checks, so a simulated call or a foe without usable moves still spends the once-per-move memory; (2) the random pick (the only draw) happens before the 'no PP left' check, so a foe whose moves are all out of PP still consumes one draw; (3) the heal bonus lives in HitHealAttr by class name, an engine coupling the decomposition does not see; (4) the ability text says a 'direct hit', but canApply has no direct-hit test beyond the PostAttack dispatch.

blocks.label: Store an impact charge when a foe's hit damages me
blocks.summary: When a foe's move damages me, I store 1 impact charge, up to 3. A multi-hit move counts once. My next Ground move spends the charges for extra power.
examples: Gain 1 stored charge each time a foe's attack damages me, up to 3
blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE for the EFFECT only; the trigger (after I am hit) and the gate are separate. Justified: the effect adds 1 to a private per-Pokemon counter capped at 3 and records which foe move was counted, both read and spent by a different attr (PorousPowerAbAttr). The library has no 'charge counter' memory block (requested in requests/B13.md as `effect.store-charge` / `time.charges`), and `effect.arm-effect` has no stack count or cap, so the effect cannot be split without re-implementing the counter. Users: Porous (5974, attr 2). ODDITY (not fixed): apply has no `simulated` check, so a simulated PostDefend call would add a charge and queue the message; the L1/L2 harness never simulates PostDefend. The ability text says 'direct hit', but canApply tests only damage > 0 and a landed hit.

blocks.label: Spend impact charges to boost my Ground moves
blocks.summary: My Ground move gains 25% power per stored charge (up to +75% with 3) and all charges are spent. Example: 2 charges turn 100 power into 150.
blocks.whenLabel: While the game calculates a move's power
examples: My next Ground move is 25% stronger for every charge I stored
feasibility: I must have at least one stored impact charge (a private counter, checked inside the class)
blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE for the EFFECT only; the trigger (move power) and the move-type condition are separate and bound to a library atom. Justified: the multiplier is derived from a private counter (1 + 0.25 x charges, not a constant the multiply-power block can hold) and the same effect spends the counter and queues a message; splitting would re-implement the counter. The library has no 'multiply by an amount per stored charge' effect, no 'stored charges' condition and no 'spend charges' effect (requested in requests/B13.md). The 'has a charge' clause stays in the class as the residual (listed under 'also requires') and keeps its original second position. Users: Porous (5974, attr 3). ODDITIES (not fixed): (1) apply multiplies power even when simulated but only spends the charges when not simulated (correct for a preview); (2) the base class's multiplier argument (1) is dead because apply is overridden; (3) the boost is computed from the counter AT the time the power is calculated, so a power calculation that is not followed by the real move (a preview that is not marked simulated) would spend charges early.

blocks.label: Clear my stored impact charges when I enter
blocks.summary: When I enter the battle, any impact charges I had stored are lost and my counter starts again from 0.
examples: Start every switch-in with no stored impact charges
blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE, justified: the effect is the reset of a private per-Pokemon record (stacks and the last counted foe move) that only the Porous attrs read; the library has no 'charge counter' memory block to express a reset of (requested as `effect.reset-charges` together with the counter in requests/B13.md). It is a single assignment, so there is nothing further to split. The trigger is a normal switch-in WHEN and the class has no condition. Users: Porous (5974, attr 0). ODDITY (not fixed): apply ignores `simulated`, so a simulated PostSummon call would reset the counter; no engine path simulates PostSummon today.
